suppress.notes: [cpe-name-collision] AndroidX SQLite 2.5.1 is a Java API wrapper over the Android framework's SQLite. CVE-2015-5895 is a CPE match for old upstream SQLite C releases, not code these AndroidX artifacts carry. Their classes do ship in both release APKs (Room uses them), but neither APK bundles a native SQLite library, so the affected C code is the OS's. Re-evaluate if a bundled SQLite build is added.

[cpe-name-collision] CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build cache metadata in the Kotlin compiler and Gradle plugin before 2.4.20 (JetBrains scores it 6.7, local access with high privileges; the NVD CPE matches every Kotlin artifact at 9.8). The standard library carries no build cache code, so this is a vendor-wide CPE match rather than affected code. Re-evaluate if a stdlib release ever ships build cache handling.

[host-only] CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build cache metadata in the Kotlin compiler and Gradle plugin before 2.4.20 (JetBrains scores it 6.7, local access with high privileges). These Kotlin tooling jars occur only in build-host configurations (AGP's built-in Kotlin compiler and build-tools classpaths, androidLintTool, annotation processor paths, unified-test-platform), never in a release APK. The repository has no Kotlin sources, so no Kotlin compilation reads build cache metadata, release builds run with --no-build-cache, and no remote build cache is configured. Re-evaluate before adding Kotlin sources or a remote cache, and drop this rule once AGP's built-in Kotlin moves to 2.4.20 or later.
